title: Chaos to Creation
subtitle: Longevity & Regeneration Frontiers
tagline: Redefining life, aging, and human potential.
summary: A work of science and argument about why we age — and whether the body's own repair systems can be persuaded to hold the line.
description: Chaos to Creation is an examination of the science shaping human longevity. Drawing on more than three decades in orthopaedic surgery and research, Professor Gordon Slater surveys the cellular and genetic mechanisms of aging and assesses what stem cells, gene editing, and emerging biotechnology may mean for the length and quality of human life. Written for general and professional readers alike, the book sets out the current evidence, the open questions, and the practical implications of a field moving from laboratory to clinic.
